about: The team's stand-ups (the operator, 2 November 2026): two a day, at 13:00 and 18:00 Lisbon time (UTC in November), from 2 November to 13 November. Not a status round: decisions first, then questions, ideas and quick syncs, with everyone's pre-meeting briefing read before. The agenda builds through the day: any person or agent adds an item, to the next stand-up or to one further out, with admin/tools/agenda.mjs. Each item is one file in data/meetings/<meeting id>/, so many can add at once without colliding.
title: Stand-up
timezone: Europe/Lisbon, which is UTC in November
rules: Not a status round: what people did is in their briefing, read before.
Decisions first, then questions, then ideas, then quick syncs.
Every decision item has options and a recommendation, and is recorded in the decider's own words.
An item not reached carries over to the next stand-up by itself.
Anyone, person or agent, can add an item to any future stand-up, at any time.
